stem: A room's average VPD is within the intended range, but plants near one wall consistently show different water-demand symptoms. What is the best next step?
choices: Check spatial temperature and humidity conditions near the affected plants rather than relying only on the room average
Assume the average proves every canopy position is equivalent
Change fertilizer concentration before checking the environment
Ignore the localized pattern because VPD is a room-wide number
rationale: Room averages can conceal local gradients. A spatially repeated symptom pattern warrants measurements at representative canopy locations before changing unrelated variables.
